bug_semantics: Reflected XSS of GET c_id on the board comment view. Comment skins interpolate $c_id into an HTML attribute (<input type="hidden" name="comment_id" value="..." id="comment_id">) with no attribute encoding. Before 2021, $c_id came from @extract($_GET) in common.php. From 27e9af5e, bbs/view_comment.php assigns clean_xss_tags($_GET["c_id"], 1, 1), which still leaves quotes and on*/style attributes, so a crafted c_id breaks out of the attribute or injects event-handler/CSS payloads.
flaw_origin: 1a60978568013aace090af413512eba936303eb9 (2013-03-14) is the first public write of the HTML sink: it changed the comment-form hidden input from empty value='' to value="<?=$c_id?>" while common.php already ran @extract($_GET). Parent 8ba59fe9b0958f3789026ceb3b8128fb2aca85a9 still has skin/board/basic/view_comment.skin.php but that blob does not echo $c_id. Parallel g5 dump 41d21074 (2013-09-13) re-adds the same sink on a README-only parent and is not the first write. 27e9af5e (2021-01-04) only adds the later, bypassable clean_xss_tags assignment in bbs/view_comment.php; the XSS dataflow already existed. Direct one-parent commit; parent tree lacks the echo-$c_id line; no finer public member reconstructs that first write.

evidence: CVE-2025-60859/GHSA-q4rc-8r6m-mw3q: reflected XSS via crafted c_id in bbs/view_comment.php. cveawg.mitre.org state PUBLISHED 2025-10-23, not rejected/withdrawn. Pre-fix blame of bbs/view_comment.php:10 at 9510aa9c is 27e9af5e (thisgun, 2021-01-04), which first added that assignment; parent 131b170b:bbs/view_comment.php exists (cat-file -e exit 0) but has no c_id assignment, relying on common.php @extract($_GET). git log -L and pickaxe of the echo-$c_id hidden input on skin/board/basic/view_comment.skin.php show the first HTML echo of $c_id at 1a609785 (chicpro, 2013-03-14, parent 8ba59fe9). Parent blob still has the skin file (cat-file -e exit 0) with empty comment_id value and no echo of $c_id. 1a609785 is an ancestor of the fix.
